title: Rep. David Taylor Disclosed 11 Stock Trades: Buys in Broadcom and Lam Research
content:
Rep. David Taylor (OH-2) disclosed stock trades on November 12, 2026, all dated November 3 or November 5: five purchases (Broadcom, Eaton, Installed Building Products, Lam Research, AT&T) and six sales (Amgen, Home Depot, Kroger, Eli Lilly, Procter & Gamble, Visa), each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Transaction dates: Nov 3 and Nov 5, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 12, 2026 (7 to 9 days later). Member: Rep. David Taylor, OH-2 (House). Bargo lists 17 lines; six are exact repeats of another line (Eaton, AT&T, Amgen, Kroger, Eli Lilly, Visa appear twice), so the table shows the 11 distinct lines, and the repeats may reflect separate accounts or lots.

What's been disclosed

  • Purchases: Broadcom (AVGO) and Lam Research (LRCX) on November 5, plus Eaton (ETN), Installed Building Products (IBP) and AT&T (T) on November 3, each $1,001–$15,000.
  • Sales: Amgen (AMGN), Kroger (KR), Eli Lilly (LLY) and Visa (V) on November 3, plus Home Depot (HD) and Procter & Gamble (PG) on November 5, each $1,001–$15,000.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Lam Research about 22% higher on November 13 than at purchase and Broadcom about 19% higher, while Eaton is about 9.9% lower. Among sales, Kroger is about 6.0% higher than at the sale date.
  • Timing: the filing came 7 to 9 days after the trades, well inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
7 to 9 days after the trades, which were dated November 3 and November 5. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 13 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
